title: Settings
description: An account settings page: a section rail, a profile form with photo, notification switches, a language select and a danger zone — composed from form parts.
usage: The rail switches the section; each card is an independent form. Every control is a catalog part — Field wraps Input and Textarea with labels and hints, the switches are the Switch part, the danger zone is an Alert plus a danger Button. Wire the save buttons to your backend; the page itself holds no state.
